notes.title: Complete update
notes.content:
This update arrives and adds 2 achievements, content about new choices, a dialogue with Ajea, the addition of a message from the developer, the improvement of some graphic backgrounds and the correction of text. Added new audio and music files.
We hope you will like this.
New major updates will come in 2023 in addition to small weekly updates to correct minor mistakes.

notes.title: Big update on December 15
notes.content:
A big update that will include the addition of new
choices, contents, graphical improvement of the backgrounds
and the addition of new achievements.
I hope you'll like it, it's the first big update of the game
of the game which will arrive on December 15th.
